verdict.rationale: Hatchet exposes most core functionality (workflows, concurrency rules, cron triggers, tasks) via SDKs/CLI (hatchet-docs-5, hatchet-docs-6, hatchet-docs-16, hatchet-docs-10) and provides a TUI/profile system for managing deployments, suggesting a code-first, API-centric design rather than UI-lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation asserting full parity between the dashboard UI and the API, no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found (hatchet-probe-2 shows 404s on all candidate spec paths), and enterprise/dashboard-only features like SSO and audit logs (hatchet-docs-19, hatchet-docs-20) are not shown to be API-configurable. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity claim, published OpenAPI/REST spec, evidence that admin/enterprise settings (SSO, audit logs, billing) are API-manageable, not just SDK/CLI parity for workflow operations.
